assets.title: Soybean NDVI example · 20 July
assets.context: Before disease treatment. This example is bound to the historical survey at step 159; it remains selectable later as that survey, not as a fresh observation. Supply a sharp red-yellow-green NDVI field image with a visible numeric color scale. The simulator returns one value per ridge for ridges 20–39, not a pixel raster. This image is always labelled Illustrative NDVI map and never replaces the recorded values. Use a separate image for each of the three surveys; no treatment-effect claim is implied. Prefer a repository-relative assets/media/ path for shared clones, or an accessible HTTPS URL.
